args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The BASE_URL constant falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set, and this is the value used to build the password reset link (and the rollup/report links) sent in emails. Since the file already imports `config` from "../config", BASE_URL should be derived from a proper application config value (e.g. config.publicUrl) that is guaranteed to be set correctly per environment, rather than reading process.env.PUBLIC_URL directly with a localhost fallback. This will ensure the reset-password link, the rollup report link, and the scheduled export link all point to the correct public host in production instead of silently defaulting to localhost when the env var is missing or misconfigured.
